title: Your First Program 🎉
lessonSummary: Amazing, that was awesome! 🌟 You can now use print() to show text on the screen!

tasks.instruction: Say hello to the world! Print "Hello World".
Print "I am learning Python!".

title: Variables – Your Memory 🧠
lessonSummary: Great job! 🎉 You learned how to store values in variables. Like a treasure chest!

tasks.instruction: Store "Dragon" in a variable called animal and print it.
Store the number 100 in a variable called points and print it.

title: Numbers and Maths 🔢
lessonSummary: Excellent! 🧮 You can now use Python as a calculator!

tasks.instruction: A unicorn has 10 magic points, a dragon has 7. Print their sum.
You have 6 magic potions and get 4 more. Print the product (6 * 4).

title: Data Types – What's Inside? 🔍
lessonSummary: Brilliant! 🔍 You now know the most important data types in Python!

tasks.instruction: Find out what type the number 7 is. Use type().
Find out what type "magic spell" is.

title: f-Strings – Mixing Text and Variables ✨
lessonSummary: Done it! ✨ You can now elegantly include variables in your text!

tasks.instruction: Create a variable animal with your favorite animal and print "My favorite animal is a ___!".
tasks.codeTemplate:
animal = "___"
print(f"My favorite animal is a {___}!")

tasks.instruction: Create a variable age with your age and print "I am ___ years old.".

title: Decisions with if 🤔
lessonSummary: Excellent! 🤔 You can now let Python make decisions!

tasks.instruction: A dragon has 80 health points. If it has more than 50, print "The dragon is strong!".
If an animal is "Dog", print "Woof!", otherwise print "Meow!".

title: Loops with for 🔄
lessonSummary: Perfect! 🔄 You can now repeat code with for loops!

tasks.instruction: Feed your dragon 3 times! Print "Nom nom!" three times (using range).
Print the numbers 0, 1 and 2 (use range and the loop variable).

title: Lists – Many Values at Once 📋
lessonSummary: Super! 📋 You can now store multiple values in a list!

tasks.instruction: Create a list with "Dragon", "Unicorn", "Phoenix" and print the first animal.
Print the last animal from your list (index -1).

title: Functions – Your Own Magic Spell 🪄
lessonSummary: Awesome! 🪄 You can now create your own magical functions!

tasks.instruction: Define a function cast_spell() that prints "Abracadabra!", and call it.
Define a function double(number) that doubles a number and prints it. Call it with 6.

title: Dictionaries – The Animal Encyclopedia 📖
lessonSummary: Very good! 📖 You can now store key-value pairs in dictionaries!

tasks.instruction: Create a dictionary with "Dog" → "barks" and "Cat" → "meows". Print what the dog does.
Print what the cat does.

title: Mini Challenge: Putting It All Together! 🏆
lessonSummary: Fantastic! 🏆 You have mastered all the Python basics! You are ready for the 12-week course!

tasks.instruction: Create a list [2, 4, 6] and print each number doubled (using a for loop).
Create a function total(numbers) that prints the sum of a list. Call it with [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
